name: sales-intelligence-framework
description: Portfolio demo — AI sales intelligence framework (local-first)
author: Roman Abolmasov

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d postgres && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend-ts && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && npm ci && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend-ts && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
